jobs.title: Partnership
jobs.description: Refer a Friend, Get a Year of The L Suite Product Security Learn Company Login Book a demo Login Book a demo Login Refer a Friend, Get a Year of The L Suite You've experienced how great Chamelio is or maybe just heard of us. Why not help others to enjoy it too? Refer someone you know and get a year of The L Suite membership, the peer community where 5,000+ CLOs & GCs make better decisions together. Partner with us How It Works 1 Fill Out The Form Fill out the form with your and your referral's details. 2 Both Get Notified You and your referral get notified, one of our team will reach out to them directly. 3 They Close, You're In Once deal is closed, we activate your L suite membership. What Is The L Suite? The leading peer community for CLOs, GCs, and their teams. Join 5,000+ accomplished peers from companies like Google, Meta, Amazon, Airbnb, and more Includes: Lloyd: Community-powered AI tapping 5,000+ legal teams 300+ Events: Workshops and convenings with your peer set 3,000+ Playbooks: Templates and resources from peers Benchmarking: Legal budgets, ops metrics, best practices 11,000 Vetted Resources: Peer-reviewed counsel and software CLE-on-Demand : Hundreds of hours to fulfill all your state requirements Learn More About The L Suite Refer A Friend Refer someone you know and get a year of The L Suite membership, the peer community where 5,000+ CLOs & GCs make better decisions together. *To be qualified for membership in The L Suite, one must: (a) Be a fulltime in-house counsel and/or legal ops professional and (b) Not employed by a company that sells products or services primarily to in-house counsel (including law firms, legal tech, etc.)). L Suite membership eligibility is determined by The L Suite's in its sole discretion. **On-going L Suite membership is subject to The L Suite's membership agreement and code of conduct, which The L Suite administers in its sole discretion. T hank you! We’ll get back to you as soon as we can Back to home Oops! Something went wrong while submitting the form. Eligibility & Payment First Touchpoint Referred prospects must be new to Chamelio (no existing conversations in last 90 days). Timing When they close a deal with us, you get The L Suite membership for 12 months. Membership Starts the month their deal closes. The More the Merrier Bring multiple referrals and stack your years. 1 Deal = 1 Year “NDAs used to be a bottleneck. Now, Chamelio handles the first pass and only escalates what needs legal review, cutting turnaround time from 24 hours to under an hour.” Noa Rosenberg Segalovitz General Counsel at Lightricks 60% Faster business turnaround 40% Fewer negotiation turns “It’s like adding an extra team member handling routine work like a junior associate while providing strategic insight like a seasoned attorney. The result is faster, higher-quality legal work with more bandwidth for what truly requires human judgment.” Noa Weyl General Counsel at Bizzabo "I've never seen anything like Chamelio. It's like having a mind-reading assistant that thinks alongside me, reducing our legal review time by 90%. The accuracy and quality are remarkable, allowing our team to shift from routine contract review to strategic initiatives that drive business growth." Duncan McQueen Assistant GC, Integrity "Chamelio’s platform has been a game changer for our team. Its powerful agents provide significant value, and the ability to upload agreements and instantly extract key information and analyze contract data without manual work is extremely helpful." Maayan Yaakobovich Senior Legal Counsel at Radware Top 5 things people ask before Referring 01. Who can refer? Anyone can refer. Fill out the form with the person you want to introduce to Chamelio. 02. Can I refer anyone? Refer anyone who would benefit from Chamelio: GCs, CLOs, heads of legal ops, deputy GCs. They just need to be new to Chamelio (no existing conversations in the last 90 days). They must be qualified for membership in The L Suite for this offer to be valid. Which means: (a) Must be a fulltime in-house counsel and/or legal ops professional and (b) Not employed by a company that sells products or services primarily to in-house counsel (including law firms, legal tech, etc.)). L Suite membership eligibility is determined by The L Suite's in its sole discretion. On-going L Suite membership is subject to The L Suite's membership agreement and code of conduct, which The L Suite administers in its sole discretion. 03. What happens after I submit the form? Both you and the person you referred receive an approval email. Chamelio will contact them to start the conversation. 04. When do I get L Suite membership? Once your referral signs a contract with Chamelio, The L Suite membership is yours for 12 months starting with their first billing cycle. 05. Can I stack The L Suite memberships? I already Have one Yes. Bring 2 referrals that close, get 2 years of TheL Suite. Bring 5, get 5 years. Stack as many as you can, Even if you already have one. 06. What if my referral cancels their contract? Your earned The L Suite membership is yours for the full 12 months regardless. It's a referral reward, not contingent on their ongoing relationship with Chamelio. Product Security Learn Company Careers Partnership Contact All rights reserved to Innvo AI Inc.
